d:
Some say the worst thing to give to a fairy is your name, but the wiser know that it is your size.

Unfortunately, you were none the wiser. As your eyes gleamed greedily at the opportunity to sell off a fairy for a fortune, a sadistic ploy was already in play.

Soon you find yourself shrunken at the hands of the small fairy called Tinker Bell. Though there is one big difference. SHE IS GIGANTIC. Unimaginably so. She looks even larger than mountains to you.

Will you be able to survive her sadistic desires or be consumed by them?
n: [Doujinshi] [GTSDimensionJumper] Giantess Comic - Shrunken into Tinker Bell's Plaything [AI GENERATED]
